Donnelly, Seán,  Sutton and formerly of Omagh, Co. Tyrone.  Late of the Irish Press News Paper.  31st October 2019.  Peacefully in the care of St. Patrick's Nursing Home, Baldoyle.  Beloved husband of the late Patricia.  Very sadly missed by his loving sons Gary and Damian, daughters-in-law Ruth and Sharon, his adored grandchildren Conor, Claire, Sorcha, Cian, Bronagh, Daniel, Jessica and Niall, brothers Patsy, Hugh and Noel, sisters Moire and Pearl, nieces, nephews, relatives and friends.

 

May He Rest in Peace.

 

Reposing in Staffords Funeral Home, Golf Links Road, Portmarnock on Monday, 4th November, from 4pm to 6pm.  Removal to the Church of the Resurrection, Bayside on Tuesday morning for 11am Funeral Mass, followed by burial in Fingal Cemetery.
